description: This file contains unit tests for the ElevenLabsTTSClient functionality, specifically validation methods for output format, language, and normalization settings.

classes.name: ElevenLabsTTSValidationTests
classes.description: A test case class that verifies the validation logic of the ElevenLabsTTSClient.

methods.name: testValidatedOutputFormatAllowsOnlyMp3Presets
methods.description: Verifies that the output format validation correctly accepts only predefined preset strings.

methods.name: testValidatedLanguageAcceptsTwoLetterCodes
methods.description: Ensures that language validation accepts two-letter ISO codes and rejects longer or invalid codes.

methods.name: testValidatedNormalizeAcceptsKnownValues
methods.description: Checks that normalization options are validated against a set of known values.
